messages:
alex: Kicking off a quick async check-in on the phased rollout for structured output / fn-calling. Goal: enable feature for 5% canary, validate client SDK behavior, and confirm fallback guardrails.
maya: +1. Are we still using feature_flag=structured_output_v2 and a separate compat flag for legacy clients?
sam: Yes — config we're testing:

```
feature_flag: structured_output_v2
rollout: { mode: gradual, initial_pct: 5 }
client_compat: { legacy_behavior: true, shim_enabled: false }
```

We plan to flip shim_enabled=true for the canary clients only.
jordan: How are we selecting the 5% audience? user_id hashing + workspace allowlist? any region filters?
lisa: Audience = hash(user_id) bucket in [0..99] < 5 AND workspace not in enterprise-blocklist. Region filter only for eu region customers (early opt-in). alex: Right. Also a note: server-side will attach header X-SO-Variant: "v2-shim" for canary responses so SDKs can quickly opt-out in tests.
maya: What telemetry dashboards should we watch? latency, error-rate, tok-cost, wrong-format-rate?
sam: Add: structured_output_parse_errors, fncall_invoke_fallbacks, avg_response_ms_p50/p95, token_per_response.
jordan: Can we add a panic fallback: if structured_output_parse_errors > 0.5% over 5m window AND fncall_invoke_fallbacks > 0.2% then auto-disable for that rollout bucket?
lisa: Yes, we have cooldown hooks in the rollout engine. Need the exact thresholds pushed to the rollout policy PR.
alex: I'll create PR to update rollout policy with those thresholds. tagging @deploy-bot to create a canary release record.
deploy-bot: Canary release record created: canary/so-v2/1979123456. Rollout policy: 5% -> 10% -> 25% after manual sign-offs. Monitoring link: https://console.redwood/monitoring/canary/so-v2-1979123456
maya: QA steps for SDK teams: 1) pull SDK vs master, 2) enable client shim flag locally, 3) run quick-suite: `make so-smoke` 4) verify header X-SO-Variant present and parsing OK.
sam: Quick curl example to exercise server path:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Client-Id: test-cli" \
  -d '{"prompt":"call calc.add","features":["structured_output_v2"]}'

Expect: JSON with `tool_calls` array OR `structured_output` object depending on variant.
jordan: Who's owning the canary watch this week (on-call for SO)?
lisa: I'll own the first 2 hours after flip (10:00–12:00 UTC). @maya can you take the 12:00–16:00 UTC block?
maya: Yep, I'll watch dashboards and keep an eye on parse error alerts. If anything suspicious, we'll roll back to legacy flag.
alex: One more: SDK behavior differences. We need to document in the SDK changelog that when shim_enabled=true clients will get extra top-level fields. Add snippet in changelog before rollout.
sam: I'll open a short PR in docs and post link here when ready.
lisa: Action items recap:
- alex: rollout policy PR (thresholds + cooldown) -> due EOD
- sam: docs + curl examples PR -> due tomorrow morning
- deploy-bot: record created (done)
- lisa & maya: on-call monitoring windows
- sdk teams: run smoke tests and report parsing success by channel #eng-runtime

alex: Cool. If no objections I'll flip the 5% bucket at 10:00 UTC tomorrow. Otherwise reply here.
maya: No objections from me. :thumbsup:
sam: All good. :+1:
jordan: Fine here.
